text: This might be a bit of a silly one so apologies in advance. I've got my niece staying with me this week, she's 6, and since yesterday afternoon she's had a bit of a temperature, it was 38.3 when I checked just now. She's also had runny poos a few times today, I think maybe three or four? Not sure if that's a lot for a kid her age, I don't have any of my own so I'm a bit out of my depth. She's drinking well though, keeps asking for water and squash, and she's been going for a wee normally as far as I can tell. I just didn't want to ring my sister and panic her when she's away if it's nothing, but I also didn't want to ignore it. Is this the sort of thing that just runs its course or should I be doing something?
